description: This file declares the interface IHealthcheckServiceFactory, which provides a factory method to create instances of IHealthcheckService, used within the Rialto server manager's common namespace. It includes necessary headers and defines a pure virtual function for creating health check services, indicating it is an abstract factory interface.

classes.name: IHealthcheckServiceFactory
classes.description: An abstract factory interface for creating IHealthcheckService instances within the Rialto server manager's common namespace.

methods.name: createHealthcheckService
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create and return a unique pointer to an IHealthcheckService, given a reference to an ISessionServerAppManager.
